name: Differentiable Uncalibrated Imaging Framework
aliases: Joint optimization of measurement coordinates and representation
definition: A differentiable imaging framework that addresses uncertainty in measurement coordinates (such as sensor locations and projection angles) by formulating the problem as measurement interpolation at unknown nodes, supervised through the forward operator.
summary: The Differentiable Uncalibrated Imaging Framework jointly optimizes continuous measurement representations and uncertain coordinates to reconstruct images without fine-tuning or distributional tradeoffs.
